## Details

<a id="end_bout"></a>
### [`end_bout`](../../../../src/combat/end_of_bout.asm#L6) `$83F5`

*routine*

After a kill, waits until the loser is at X $28 or more. Then the winner turns and walks back to its start position.

- **Called from:** [`$80F4`](../../../../src/main/main_loop.asm#L26)
